stages.label: Learn
stages.lead: Read the essential ideas and worked example before checking your understanding.

blocks.title: Why compress files?
blocks.text: Compression reduces the amount of storage needed and can reduce transmission times.

blocks.title: Lossless
blocks.text: Lossless compression makes files smaller while allowing exact reconstruction of every original bit. Use it for source code and important documents.

blocks.title: Lossy
blocks.text: Lossy compression permanently removes some data. It can reduce photos, music or video file sizes when some loss of quality is acceptable.

blocks.title: Calculating savings
blocks.text: Storage saved = original size − compressed size. Keep units consistent; if asked for a percentage, divide by original size and multiply by 100.

blocks.title: Visual model · Compression and Storage Calculations
blocks.caption: Lossless preserves exact data; lossy may sacrifice information for further size reduction.

blocks.title: Worked model · A text program and a photograph must be compressed. Choose a method for each and calculate the saving if a photo falls from 800 KB to 500 KB.
blocks.text: Source code must remain exact, so choose lossless compression. A website photograph may use lossy compression if some detail loss is acceptable. Subtract compressed size: 800 KB − 500 KB = 300 KB saved. Percentage saved = 300 ÷ 800 × 100 = 37.5%.

items: compression — Reducing the number of bits needed to represent a file.
lossless — Compression that allows the original to be restored exactly.
lossy — Compression that permanently removes some original data.
file size — The quantity of storage required for a file.

questions.prompt: Which compression type can restore the original data exactly?
questions.feedback: Lossless is reversible without changing the original data.

questions.prompt: Which compression type may permanently discard some image details?
questions.feedback: Lossy compression may discard original information irreversibly.

questions.prompt: A file shrinks from 800 KB to 500 KB. How many KB are saved?
